title: application-core Phase 5 step 3: lib/tests/integration.rs at the merged revision, JBMC's tests included
description: Runs lib/tests/integration.rs as it is (65 tests, none ignored), several of which run JBMC (stock jbmc, --engine jbmc or auto, with --confirm) and replay witnesses on a JVM. Nothing has run these tests on the merged code of the four application-core streams and Phase 5's interface requests: the merge's and every later cycle's inline checks ran every other test binary, but not this one, whose tests run JBMC. It last passed at the cleanup merge (job 20261107-215001-cleanup-merge-lib-tests-integration-rs-a, 64 tests). Since then: the checked-exception harness test (Phase 0 step 7, VF-015) was added, and the String parameter test now expects --engine jbmc refused by name (it never reaches JBMC). The code is this job's commit (application-core Phase 5 step 3), whose parent is 4d6c6279 (yrlkzqvw, a String inside an object); it descends from c99d01a3 (szqvvxuv), whose relocate::opened_with opens package-private and protected instance methods for the JVM run of a witness. Domains, engines and bounds are each test's own. Expected: every test passes and cargo exits 0. Acceptance: llm-dlc/loops/application-core.md, Phase 5 step 3 (the existing examples and lib/tests/integration.rs keep their expected outcomes); a JBMC timeout here would be VF-018's kind, which doesn't block native feature work.
